source.title: Rational rotation-minimizing frames -- recent advances and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 7037825. Local shard metadata identified the exact work as 'Rational rotation-minimizing frames -- recent advances and open problems' (2016), DOI 10.1016/j.amc.2015.04.122, with candidate links to the DOI route and eScholarship item 8dk4s1kd. Metadata was used only to identify the exact work and candidate full-text routes.

Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged for direct zbMATH and eScholarship access, network_or_dns_failure for local shell access to api.zbmath.org and intermittent shell DNS resolution, and metadata_only for DOI/ScienceDirect/IDEAS resolver pages. Direct fetch of https://zbmath.org/7037825 returned a Cloudflare challenge. The documented zbMATH REST endpoint pattern and local curl attempts to api.zbmath.org failed DNS resolution in the run environment.

Ran exact-work recovery using the zbMATH identifier 7037825, exact title, DOI 10.1016/j.amc.2015.04.122, and eScholarship item identifier 8dk4s1kd. Search recovered an exact eScholarship PDF URL for the same work, but the page and direct PDF endpoint returned JavaScript/WAF challenge pages rather than a readable PDF. ScienceDirect exposed only an article preview and section snippets, not the full article body. IDEAS/RePEc and related index pages exposed bibliographic metadata or links to restricted publisher access. A UBC BIRS lecture page with a closely related but different title was rejected as a different source. Search snippets were rejected as extraction evidence because the workflow forbids extracting from snippets rather than a readable PDF or full HTML source.

No candidates were mapped, extracted, rewritten, deduplicated, or accepted because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact containing the technical problem statements could be confirmed and accessed. The source adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, article previews, abstracts, bibliographic records, search snippets, or a related lecture page.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/7037825.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
